description: Ω8 discovery engine — inference. Consumes an ApplicationGraph (plain JSON payload: inline graph object OR a vault ref) emitted by the Ω7 perception/observation engines and infers candidate SurfaceContracts (discovery.surfacecontract@1): buttons with action-word labels → click contracts with risk hints, fields → typing contracts, lists → read contracts. Every candidate MUST cite the node's evidence refs (vault objects, ns 'discovery') — no evidence, no candidate. Confidence is a RECORDED heuristic (label-match strength), never a promotion input: promotion belongs to discovery.verify@1. The engine's only outputs are candidates + evidence persisted to the user's vault.

engine.doc: infer {graph, runId?} → {runId, candidates[], vaultRef} — graph is an inline ApplicationGraph or a vault ref {ns,id,rev}; candidates are DRAFT SurfaceContracts citing graph evidence, appended to the vault (ns 'discovery', id 'candidates:<runId>'). Semantic risk class: READ (inference observes data; risk fields are legal on contract-kind contributions only per the pinned manifest grammar, so the class lives here as documentation).

fields.name: id
fields.doc: candidate id, unique within an inference run (sc-<n>), referenced by mapping bindings and verification probes

fields.name: nodeId
fields.doc: the ApplicationGraph node the candidate was inferred from (traceability to perception evidence)

fields.name: op
fields.doc: label-derived op name, e.g. message.send (binds against a blueprint op like message.send@1 by name)

fields.name: selector
fields.doc: the node's selectorHint; empty selectors fail mapping's non-empty constraint

fields.name: actionType
fields.doc: click | type | read — how the surface is driven

fields.name: riskHint
fields.doc: EXTERNAL_MUTATION | MUTATION | READ — inferred risk hint; mapping requires compatibility with the blueprint op's declared risk

fields.name: evidence
fields.doc: EvidenceRef[] {ns,id,rev} — vault refs carried from the graph node; MANDATORY: a node without evidence yields no candidate

fields.name: status
fields.doc: DRAFT | PROMOTED | REJECTED — candidates are born DRAFT; only discovery.verify@1 may rewrite to PROMOTED (probe evidence ≥ policy threshold); REJECTED is reserved for explicit future rejection

fields.name: confidence
fields.doc: 0..1 label-match heuristic (exact domain word 0.9, partial 0.6, generic 0.4) — recorded, NEVER a promotion input

schema.doc: discovery.surfacecontract@1 — the candidate contract shape produced by discovery.infer@1 and consumed by discovery.map@1 / discovery.verify@1.

capabilities.justification: The engine's only outputs are candidates + evidence in the USER'S VAULT: port:vault.append@1 persists each run's candidate set (ns 'discovery', id 'candidates:<runId>', refs = the cited evidence — provenance edges); port:vault.get@1 resolves graphs passed as vault refs (input tolerance for the Ω7 perception engines' output: caller passes the graph object or a vault ref). Both are granted per-composition by the user-signed Recipe, never by this manifest.
